title: AAPS 4.0.0.0 bug in temporary target
body:
I have the developer version installed from the Andy Rozman repository due to the improved Medtronic driver.

I think I found a small bug in this version. In this version, you can switch between the old and new interfaces. I noticed that the temporary target differs between the two interfaces (video below), and I think the values ​​should be the same. The new interface has 107 and the old one has 116.
